recall.define: Define construction frontier, borrow guard, strong reference, weak reference and pinning using exact validity events.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish acquired storage from initialized ownership, weak retention from live value access, and cancellation from quiescence.
recall.apply: A copied owner is consumed twice, a weak reference outlives its value and a cancelled I/O buffer is rebound. Identify the first broken invariant in each trace and a changed-condition repair.
